name: FVU Validation (Headless GUI)

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [fvu_validation]

jobs:
  run-fvu-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17' # Adjust to 8 if the FVU JAR requires Java 8

      - name: Install xvfb (Virtual Framebuffer for Java Swing)
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb
        
      - name: Verify xvfb Installation
        run: |
          which xvfb-run
          xvfb-run -a echo "xvfb virtual display is functioning correctly"

      - name: Prepare Input and Output Directories
        run: |
          mkdir -p inputs outputs
          
          # Write the TXT file payload to disk
          echo "${{ github.event.client_payload.fileContent }}" > "inputs/${{ github.event.client_payload.fileName }}"
          
          # Write the CSI file payload to disk if it exists
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.client_payload.csiFileName }}" ]; then
            echo "${{ github.event.client_payload.csiFileContent }}" > "inputs/${{ github.event.client_payload.csiFileName }}"
          fi

      - name: Execute FVU Validator (Headless via xvfb)
        run: |
          TXT_FILE="inputs/${{ github.event.client_payload.fileName }}"
          
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.client_payload.csiFileName }}" ]; then
            CSI_FILE="inputs/${{ github.event.client_payload.csiFileName }}"
          else
            CSI_FILE="0"
          fi
          
          OUT_DIR="outputs"
          
          # Execute the Java GUI application headlessly using xvfb-run -a
          xvfb-run -a -e xvfb_error.log java -cp "fvu-tool/*:fvu-tool/TDS_STANDALONE_FVU_1.2.jar" com.tin.FVU.FVU "$TXT_FILE" "$OUT_DIR/err.err" "$OUT_DIR/fvu.fvu" "0" "$CSI_FILE" || (cat xvfb_error.log && exit 1)
          cat xvfb_error.log || true

      - name: Upload Generated Output (FVU/ERR)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fvu-validation-results-${{ github.event.client_payload.jobId }}
          path: outputs/
          retention-days: 1
